answers.core: Fog shaders are core to volumetric fog functionality, and instance-level control is a natural extension that aligns with Godot's existing material uniform system, enhancing flexibility without bloating the engine.
answers.workaround: No. The lack of instance-level control makes it cumbersome to achieve unique fog effects without duplicating shaders for each use case.

title: Add per-instance uniform support to Fog shaders
